info.title: MovieTix API
info.description: API for browsing shows, booking seats, and administering the MovieTix platform. All error responses share a standard shape: `{ success: false, message, code, requestId }`.

servers.description: Relative to whichever host is serving this app

bearerAuth.description: Clerk session token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

example.message: Too many requests, please try again later.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's bookings
get.description: Auth: signed-in user.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter to a single tab category; omit to get all bookings.

post.summary: Toggle a movie in the authenticated user's favorites list
post.description: Auth: signed-in user. Adds movieId if absent, removes it if already present.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's favorite movies
get.description: Auth: signed-in user.

post.summary: Follow a movie to get notified when a show is first added for it

get.summary: Check whether the authenticated user follows a movie
get.description: Auth: signed-in user.

get.summary: Get all movies the authenticated user follows
get.description: Auth: signed-in user.

get.summary: List theaters, optionally filtered by city

409.description: A theater with this name already exists in this city

get.summary: Get movies currently playing (from TMDB)
get.description: Auth: admin only.

get.summary: Search for a movie by title (local DB first, falls back to TMDB)
get.description: Auth: admin only. Used by the Add Show movie picker.

post.summary: Add a new show (creates the movie record if it doesn't exist yet)
post.description: Auth: admin only. A theater-admin may only add shows to a screen belonging to their own theater (403 otherwise); super-admins may target any screen.

get.summary: List all movies with at least one upcoming show
get.description: Auth: none (public). Rate limited per IP.

get.summary: Search movies with upcoming shows by title/overview (falls back to TMDB if none found locally)
get.description: Auth: none (public). Rate limited per IP.

get.summary: Get movies sharing at least one genre with the given movie
get.description: Auth: none (public). Rate limited per IP. Pulled from the local Movie collection (movies already synced via addShow). Returns an empty array if the movie has no recorded genres, or if fewer than 2 similar movies are found.

get.summary: Get a movie's details plus its upcoming showtimes grouped by date
get.description: Auth: none (public). Rate limited per IP.

put.summary: Edit a show's date/time and/or price
put.description: Auth: admin only, scoped to the owning theater. Changing showDateTime is blocked with a 409 if the show has any paid bookings; any pending (unpaid) reservations are invalidated (seats released, booking deleted, user notified by email).

delete.description: Auth: admin only, scoped to the owning theater. Soft-deletes (isCancelled: true) so historical booking records remain valid; blocked with a 409 if the show has any paid bookings. Any pending (unpaid) reservations are invalidated.

get.summary: List screens, optionally filtered by theater

parameters.name: theaterId
parameters.description: Filter to screens belonging to this theater

post.summary: Create a screen with a seat-row layout under a theater

409.description: A screen with this name already exists in this theater

patch.summary: Update a screen's name and/or seat-row layout
patch.description: Auth: admin only (theater-admins may only edit screens belonging to their own theater; 403 otherwise). Editing rows is blocked (409) if the screen has any upcoming show, since changing seat counts/types would invalidate already-sold seat IDs.

409.description: Screen has upcoming shows; rows cannot be edited

post.summary: Submit or edit a review for a movie
post.description: Auth: signed-in user. Only succeeds if the caller has a paid booking for a show of this movie whose showDateTime is in the past. One review per user per movie — submitting again edits the existing review instead of creating a duplicate.

403.description: Caller has no completed paid booking for this movie

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's own review for a movie, if any
get.description: Auth: signed-in user. Used to pre-fill the review form for editing.

200.description: The caller's review, or null if none exists

get.summary: Get all reviews and the average rating for a movie
get.description: Auth: none (public). Rate limited per IP.

get.summary: Get personalized movie recommendations for the authenticated user
get.description: Auth: signed-in user. v1 scores not-yet-booked bookable movies by weighted genre-overlap with the user's paid booking history (weighted higher) and followed movies (weighted lower), tie-broken by TMDB rating. Falls back to rating-only ranking when the user has no booking/follow history, or when no genre overlap exists with any candidate.

200.description: Up to 5 recommended movies, each with a plain-language reason

post.summary: Reserve seats for a show and create a Stripe checkout session

200.description: Booking created, Stripe checkout URL returned

get.summary: Get currently occupied seats for a show
get.description: Auth: none (public). Rate limited per IP — this is the most scrapable route, so it has a stricter limit than other public endpoints.

get.summary: Get the payment status of a booking
get.description: Auth: signed-in user (must own the booking).

post.summary: Cancel a paid booking, refund via Stripe, and release the seats
post.description: Auth: signed-in user (must own the booking). Must be at least the theater's cancellation cutoff (default 2 hours) before the showtime.

get.summary: Download an .ics calendar event for a paid booking
get.description: Auth: signed-in user (must own the booking). Only available for paid bookings. Event start/end are computed from the show's showDateTime and the movie's runtime (falls back to 2 hours if runtime is missing).

get.summary: Check whether the authenticated user is an admin
get.description: Auth: admin only (super-admin or theater-admin). (protectAdmin already rejects non-admins with 403, so a 200 response always means true.)

200.description: Confirmation of admin status, plus the caller's specific role

get.summary: Get aggregate dashboard stats (bookings, revenue, active shows, user count)
get.description: Auth: admin only. A theater-admin's totals are scoped to their own theater; totalUser is only populated for super-admins (null otherwise, since users aren't theater-scoped).

get.summary: List all upcoming shows (admin view)
get.description: Auth: admin only. A theater-admin only sees shows at their own theater; super-admins see all.

get.summary: List all paid bookings (admin view)
get.description: Auth: admin only. A theater-admin only sees bookings for shows at their own theater; super-admins see all.
